hypotheses.binder: (hNS : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∈ S)
hypotheses.justification: The proof uses hNS only inside `hfrob`, to turn `ℓ ∉ S` into `¬ ℓ ∣ N`, which hρ', hθ and ha need. The result of `hfrob` is only passed to `GaloisRepAdic.charpoly_eq_of_charpoly_frobenius_eq` (Theorems/Thm_GaloisRepAdic_charpoly_eq_of_charpoly_frobenius_eq.lean). That lemma accepts an arbitrary `S : Finset ℕ` and only needs the Frobenius charpoly equality for primes ℓ ∉ S. So without hNS, apply it with `S ∪ N.primeFactors`. Take a prime ℓ ∉ S ∪ N.primeFactors. Then ℓ ∉ S. Also ¬ ℓ ∣ N, by `Nat.mem_primeFactors : p ∈ n.primeFactors ↔ p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n ∧ n ≠ 0` together with N ≠ 0 from the `[NeZero N]` that the theorem already takes. With ℓ ∉ S and ¬ ℓ ∣ N, the rest of `hfrob` goes through unchanged: rewrite with charpoly_residual, charpoly_baseChangeAlong, hρ', hθ, then simp and ha. The rest of the proof (`isEquiv_of_isAbsolutelyIrreducible_of_charpoly_eq` with habs' and habs.baseChangeAlong) does not involve S at all. hNS is mentioned nowhere else in the statement, so deleting it is possible. The proof sketch has not been compiled.
